_comment: Configuration for `pnpm perf:xproc:gate` — see bench/xproc-gate.ts and docs/design/perf-gates.md.
_rounds: Rounds PER SHARD; CI runs 10 shards. Sized by the bootstrap in docs/design/perf-harness-interleaving.md so every case has power >= 0.84 against both a uniform 2% slowdown and one process in five 20% slower, under the steady-state warm-up below.
_alpha: Per case, split between the median sign test and the mean sign-flip test; a case fails if either does.
_warmup: A worker warms for BOTH the parse count and the time. A count alone stopped some processes before V8 finished tiering: css/stylesheet ran 14% faster after 1.5 s of warm-up than after 40 parses, and that difference varies between processes.
